name: MutualActionPlanEditor
tagline: Buyer and seller mutual action plan for an opportunity, stored in one text column: milestones with phase, side (buyer / seller / joint), owner, due date, duration…
description: Buyer and seller mutual action plan for an opportunity, stored in one text column: milestones with phase, side (buyer / seller / joint), owner, due date, duration, predecessor and buyer confirmation. Shows plan health against the target close date with a projected close and slip days, a timeline with a close-date marker, KPI filters, search, grouping, a validated add/edit form, back-scheduling from the close date with templates, start / done / blocked / reopen actions, a shift-open-dates re-plan, a readable plan summary for the buyer, a phone layout, and Power Fx outputs and events.
features: Side (buyer / seller / joint), owner, due date, duration
Shows plan health against the target close date with a projected close and slip days
A timeline with a close-date marker, KPI filters, search, grouping
Back-scheduling from the close date with templates
A readable plan summary for the buyer
